I'm looking to book a hotel in Paris for May 1st to May 5th.
            Can you suggest a hotel that's under 210? If there are a few choices, go for the one with the highest rating.
            Please give me the hotel's name, rating, price range. Also, can you add an event called "Booking hotel {hotel_name}" to my calendar on April 25th 2024, and set the location to the hotel's address? Just to remind me to book ahead of time. Thanks!

```python
# Get all hotels in Paris
hotels_in_paris = get_all_hotels_in_city("Paris")

# Get the prices of the hotels
hotel_prices = get_hotels_prices(hotels_in_paris.split(", "))

# Get the ratings of the hotels
hotel_ratings = get_rating_reviews_for_hotels(hotels_in_paris.split(", "))

# Filter hotels by price and get the one with the highest rating
affordable_hotels = {hotel: price for hotel, price in hotel_prices.items() if float(price) < 210}
if affordable_hotels:
    best_hotel = max(affordable_hotels, key=lambda hotel: float(hotel_ratings[hotel]))
    best_hotel_price = affordable_hotels[best_hotel]
    best_hotel_rating = hotel_ratings[best_hotel]

    # Get the address of the best hotel
    hotel_address = get_hotels_address(best_hotel)

    # Create a calendar event
    create_calendar_event(
        f"Booking hotel {best_hotel}",
        "2024-04-25 00:00",
        "2024-04-25 01:00",
        f"Book {best_hotel} ahead of time",
        None,
        hotel_address,
    )

    print(f"Hotel: {best_hotel}, Rating: {best_hotel_rating}, Price: {best_hotel_price}")
else:
    print("No hotels found under 210")
```
